rules: Every planned mutation must have a corresponding verified applied result or an explicit failure reason.
Complete means every executable planned operation is verified.
Partial means at least one planned operation verified and at least one did not.
Failed means no executable planned operation verified.
Noop means there were no executable planned mutations.
Luna must never say done/complete/success when status is partial or failed.
Verification compares planned action, target index/scope, and relevant target metadata where available.
Verification reports unmatched planned operations; it does not silently invent a repair.
Credits remain governed by the billing layer; this verifier controls truthfulness, not pricing.
Build, update, publish, and navigation executors expose verification results before any final action reply.
